observed_title: 你用它上網，我用它進你內網! 中華電信數據機遠端代碼執行漏洞

retrieval.quote_verification: All five quotations passed exact, unnormalized inclusion checks against the original rendered paragraph or list item and document.body.innerText using agent_browser eval in session orange-O015; their preceding headings were also observed.

reason: The article supports reusable artifact-availability routing, help-based interface enumeration, function-led hypothesis selection, and review of unmatched-input routing after unsuccessful ordinary-handler analysis. Its disclosure chronology also exposes a residual manual-update cohort after reported completion. These method observations are separable from the omitted exploitation sequence.

workflow.decision: First ask which implementation and interface artifacts are available. When visibility is behavioral only, use the interface's help facility to seed an operation inventory; keep implementation questions unresolved until suitable artifacts become available.
Use advertised function semantics to form a concrete implementation hypothesis and prioritize its handler slice, rather than attempting undirected reconstruction of the entire artifact.

When ordinary-handler review yields no serious finding, record that negative result and change the review question to what happens when no advertised operation matches. Treat fallback routing as a separate behavior contract, not as evidence that the ordinary handlers are safe.

Reconcile a reported rollout completion with later unresolved update cohorts. Keep residual manual work and disclosure timing explicit instead of treating an earlier completion statement as universal closure.

tools.purpose: List advertised functions to seed an operation and handler-review inventory.
tools.when: During authorized black-box interface mapping when built-in help is available; the resulting list is not proof of exhaustive dispatch coverage.

handoffs.when: A permitted implementation artifact becomes available and the remaining question concerns how a prioritized interface operation is implemented.

handoffs.acceptance_gate: Identify the permitted artifact and one evidence-backed operation to prioritize. Actor, configuration and gates must be explicit or marked unknown; an advertised function name is not proof of its implementation or reachability.

handoffs.when: Ordinary handler analysis is unrevealing and recovered control flow identifies a distinct unmatched-input behavior-selection path.

handoffs.acceptance_gate: Require evidence for an alternate selection edge, not merely absence of an ordinary-path finding. Preserve static-inference status and unknown reachability; the receiving skill must not promote a reconstructed branch into demonstrated impact.

limitations: Execution, exposure and affected-population claims remain author reports, not independent verification. The population estimate covered only devices online at observation time, and the complete affected-device inventory was unavailable; no scanning or target testing was performed here.

The author's increased implementation visibility involved access to their own device. Such local management access does not establish reachability through the originally exposed interface; the access-acquisition sequence is intentionally omitted.

The unsuccessful ordinary-handler review has no supplied coverage denominator or benign differential-validation protocol. Recovered pseudocode is described as assembly-based reconstruction, not independently checked source or proof that all other handlers were safe.
The chronology records reported completion followed by remaining manual updates. It does not supply patch diffs, deployed-artifact receipts or independent confirmation of complete fix coverage.

candidate_additions.guidance: Record source, executable and interface-documentation availability before selecting the next audit mode. A built-in help listing seeds the interface inventory but does not establish complete behavior coverage.

Prioritize a bounded handler slice using an explicit hypothesis drawn from operation semantics. Preserve unsuccessful review and unknown coverage rather than expanding automatically into whole-artifact reconstruction.

Include unmatched-input and default-delegation branches in the behavior-selection model. Review their validation and privilege contracts independently of advertised operations; a negative ordinary-path review does not close them.

Track bulk-update and manual-update cohorts separately. A reported completion must not close residual groups; keep their deployment status, remaining work and disclosure constraints visible until closure is evidenced.
